entries.heading: EXTENSION OF PHYSICIAN FEE SCHEDULE MENTAL HEALTH ADD-ON
ancestors: TITLE III—IMPROVING THE QUALITY AND EFFICIENCY OF HEALTH CARE
Subtitle B—Improving Medicare for Patients and Providers
entries.text:
SEC. 3107. EXTENSION OF PHYSICIAN FEE SCHEDULE MENTAL HEALTH ADD-ON.

    Section 138(a)(1) of the Medicare Improvements for Patients and 
Providers Act of 2008 (Public Law 110-275) is amended by striking ``December 31, 2009'' and inserting 
``December 31, 2010''.
